typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFullPath as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DB as string (),
	FalloutArchivePath as string (),
	FallOutFileName as string (),
	FallOutQuery as string (),
	InboundFileName as string (),
	InputFile as string (),
	MailFrom as string (),
	MailTo as string (),
	MessageSource as string (),
	OutboundFileName as string (),
	OutboundFilePath as string (),
	OutputFullPath as string (),
	PWD as string (),
	RUNID as string (),
	TotalRecords as integer (),
	USER as string ()
}

source(output(
		RESP_CODE as string,
		GROUP_ID as string,
		TERM_DATE as string,
		HCID as string,
		COB_IND as string,
		EFF_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::OutboundQuery',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Response_Code as string,
		Group_ID as string,
		TERM_DATE as string,
		HCID as string,
		COB_IND as string,
		EFF_DATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Response_Code = RESP_CODE,
		Group_ID = GROUP_ID,
		TERM_DATE,
		HCID,
		COB_IND,
		EFF_DATE)) ~> FlatFileDestination
